positive_snippets:
Hotel Mayur Palace is awesome place for stay. There is hassle free check in and check out facility. Hotel staff are very humble and polite. I experience full support from hotel staff.
Very peaceful place for stay.
negative_snippets: Never book any hotel with Agoda. They don't even provide you proper customer support. I was waiting like hell before hotel gates during midnight winters. Hotel owner advised me for not paying through websites and than provided me a room without any blanket. I had to leave the place early in the next morning. I tried for warm water but got shocks twice with Water heater and managed with cold water during mid November in delhi. I paid so much for my one mistake that I will never forget the experience.

There's no kitchen in the hotel. They get you parathas from somewhere outside. The breakfast was provided very late, at around 10:15-10:45.

Wi-Fi is there and the room service is made available immediately.

Pathetic.
No bedsheets or pillow cover.
No comfortor provided in delhi winters.
Bathroom ceiling was mouldy and sleeping.
Buckets and mugs have never been cleaned.
Geyser that's rushed, broken and noisey of switched on
